regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Sugar Bowl is forecast for about 50", 29" of it Wednesday. Kirkwood and Palisades follow. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Sugar Bowl Wednesday. The NWS is calling for more at Sugar Bowl: 45 to 75 inches Tuesday night through Sunday night. Winter Storm Warning at Sugar Bowl from Tuesday night to Friday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 34", 19" of it Wednesday. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Mammoth Wednesday and Wednesday night. The NWS is calling for more at Mammoth: 51 to 73 inches Wednesday through Sunday. Winter Storm Warning at Mammoth from Wednesday to Friday.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Alta is forecast for about 16". Snowbasin and Powder Mountain follow. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Alta Tuesday and Tuesday night. The NWS is calling for more at Alta: 34 to 58 inches Tuesday through Friday night. Winter Weather Advisory at Alta from Tuesday to Wednesday.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 10". Jackson Hole and Sun Valley follow. The NWS is calling for more at Grand Targhee: 12 to 26 inches Tuesday through Sunday. Winter Weather Advisory at Grand Targhee from Tuesday to Wednesday.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 7", 4" of it Tuesday. Taos follows. The NWS is calling for more at Wolf Creek: 12 to 21 inches Tuesday through Friday night.
